The break is in [migrateOSS](/app/lib/auth/init.go:510): it creates `ossuser` and assigns that name to users and trusted cluster mappings. The existing `admin` role remains, but migrated users no longer hold it, breaking the reported admin-to-admin mapping with older leaf clusters.

The fix should retrieve `admin`, skip migration with a debug message when it has the `OSSMigratedV6` label, and otherwise replace it with a labelled, downgraded role. [NewOSSUserRole](/app/lib/services/role.go:196) shows the reduced permissions to carry into the requested `NewDowngradedOSSAdminRole`. User and trusted cluster migration in [init.go](/app/lib/auth/init.go:548), plus legacy creation in [user_command.go](/app/tool/tctl/common/user_command.go:272), should assign `admin`. The `ossuser` deletion guard in [auth_with_roles.go](/app/lib/auth/auth_with_roles.go:1877) also needs review.

Existing [migration tests](/app/lib/auth/init_test.go:484) assert the current `ossuser` behavior; they do not establish compatibility with an older leaf. **No project source or tests were changed:** this specialist run was restricted to fault localization. I recorded the diagnosis in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Updated the OSS migration to downgrade the existing `admin` role in place. Migrated users, trusted cluster mappings, and legacy user creation now use `admin`; a role marked `OSSMigratedV6` is skipped on later runs.

The focused migration test and relevant services and tctl package checks passed.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [migrateOSS](/app/lib/auth/init.go:518) labels `admin` as migrated before updating users, trusted clusters, and GitHub connectors. If a later update fails, the next startup sees that label and skips the unfinished migration. Move the admin role update and completion label after the resource updates, and make interrupted trusted cluster CA updates retryable.

**Tests:** All executed successfully. They do not cover the interrupted migration path.

- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/auth -run '^TestMigrateOSS$' -count=1` — passed
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/services -run '^TestCheckAccessToRemoteCluster$' -count=1` — passed
- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./tool/tctl/common -count=1` — passed

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None.

Fixed the OSS migration retry path. The downgraded `admin` role and its completion label are now written after users, trusted clusters, CAs, and GitHub connectors are updated. Trusted cluster migration also checks both CAs on retry, even if an earlier attempt labeled the cluster.

Added a regression test for migration interrupted by a missing host CA. All three reviewer test commands and `git diff --check` passed. No remaining failures; TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: None.
